corruption.operation: Replace selected node-hyperedge incidences with unique nodes sampled to make each fully rewired carrier hyperedge approximately class-balanced. Original features and labels are unchanged.
corruption.label_usage: Node labels are used only to construct this declared adversarial intervention. Corruption locations and labels are never supplied to a trained method.
corruption.exact_count: B=floor(eta*M), where M is the number of original incidences
corruption.nested_rate_coupling: Within each dataset, trial, and concentration, fixed edge and incidence priorities make the corrupted position set at a lower eta a subset of every higher-eta set.
corruption.concentration_parameter: alpha in [0,1] mixes incidence and hyperedge priorities. alpha=0 is diffuse incidence placement; alpha=1 orders whole hyperedges and therefore fills a small number of carrier hyperedges before moving to the next; alpha=0.5 is intermediate.
required_diagnostics: nested corrupted position sets across the concentrated rate curve
mean corruption severity among carrier hyperedges
corruption-count Herfindahl index and effective carrier count
incidence-weighted hyperedge label purity before and after rewiring

degree_prefix.selection: Rank hyperedges by score and retain their incidences in stable order until exactly K positions are selected; at most one boundary hyperedge is partial.

spectral_prefix.score: Sum of the approximate diagonal entries of the regularized inverse node Laplacian over a hyperedge's incidences
spectral_prefix.selection: Rank hyperedges by score and retain their incidences in stable order until exactly K positions are selected; at most one boundary hyperedge is partial.

ehgnn_f.configuration_source: Fixed EHGNN-F setting used for the reported evaluations; no retuning on corrupted data.

evaluation.pairing: For a dataset-cell-trial, all methods use the same corrupted graph, split, and model seed. Random-Fixed uses one fixed trial-specific incidence ordering across cells.
evaluation.budget: Every sparse method retains exactly K=max(1,floor(0.5*t)) original incidence positions. Full retains t.

reporting.accuracy: Report mean and sample standard deviation for every method in every declared cell; no corruption level may be omitted from a plotted curve.
reporting.primary_comparison: Paired EHGNN-F minus Random-Fixed test-accuracy difference with 95% t interval and two-sided Wilcoxon test in every dataset-cell.
reporting.multiplicity: Holm-adjust the 24 EHGNN-F-versus-Random-Fixed cell tests as one declared family.
reporting.mechanism: For EHGNN-F and Random-Fixed, report the fraction of rewired incidences retained and the rewired share of the retained mask.
reporting.interpretation: The study tests a conditional mechanism. It is not an independent natural-benchmark confirmation and cannot establish universal superiority.

fixed_self_loops.budget_status: Outside the selected-incidence budget for every method
